question: Will the U.S. personal saving rate (BEA, seasonally adjusted) for April 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-04-15) be above 4.9%, its value for November 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2026-01-15 (November 2025), rounded as shown

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis
